item.title: [ESCALATING] Iran's Geopolitical Impact on Commodities — Stock and oil markets remain volatile amid Iran conflict fears
item.description: Experts warn that prolonged elevated oil and gas prices could increase the cost of goods and services. The continued volatility in stock markets and commodities is linked to concerns over the potential duration of the Iran conflict.

item.title: [ESCALATING] Iran's Geopolitical Impact on Commodities — Global X suggests increased focus on emerging markets amid Iran conflict
item.description: Global X has indicated that current geopolitical tensions, particularly the conflict involving Iran, may present an opportunity to increase investment in emerging markets. The ongoing situation is affecting sectors such as equities, commodities, and currencies, suggesting potential shifts in market dynamics.

item.title: [ESCALATING] Iran's Geopolitical Impact on Commodities — UK firms withdraw fixed energy deals amid Iran conflict-driven price surge
item.description: UK firms have significantly reduced the number of fixed-term energy deals available, with data indicating a more than 50% decline. This reduction is attributed to the surge in wholesale energy prices, driven by the ongoing conflict in Iran. The geopolitical tensions are impacting various sectors, including equities, commodities, and currencies.
